brief: Board unchanged in character: BTC and majors press the 1d lows with funding at the 10.95 neutral floor, and hl-cycles reads mild risk-off but is stale at 8.9 h. XPL and AAVE shorts closed since the last run (XPL cancelled at +0.47R, AAVE stopped at -1R). One new plan: SOL long on a failed 1d breakout, low conviction, with the 1d sma20 as first target; we lean that a bounce is the base case but the 1d trend stays down, and a 1d close under the swept low would prove it wrong. Watchlist leads with PONS crowding (HL funding 71.87 over CEX) and TRX shorts paying. Gap: hl-cycles stale.
